key_insight: QPAT uses a learnable quantum generative prior during classical model training, then performs inference entirely classically.
engineering_relevance: The framework is designed to augment LSTMs, CNNs, and Transformers without requiring quantum hardware at inference time.
method: Use a Quantum Circuit Born Machine as a task-aligned, learnable generative prior.
Apply decoupled fitness-based scoring to guide prior learning.
Use stochastic Drop-Prior to implicitly distill quantum structure into classical weights.
evidence_signal: Across six benchmarks in time-series forecasting, vision, and NLP, the abstract reports improved predictive performance and seed stability, with ablations favoring QPAT over random and classically learned priors.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify training overhead or establish robustness to realistic quantum hardware noise.
paper_title: QPAT: A Universal Quantum Machine Learning Framework for Quantum-Assisted Training and Classical Inference
